UniCC class insights currently support theory courses and compatible embedded theory/lab courses.

UniCC calculates averages and standard deviation from contributing students in the same VTOP class. Spread (SD) describes how far marks typically vary around the average.

The API provides internal marks statistics out of 60. A projected grade applies VIT’s relative boundaries after scaling your total and the sample to /100, assuming the same percentage performance in the final exam. It also assumes a theory class of more than 10 students and passing the final exam and any embedded lab. Use View grade ranges for details. Predictions need at least two contributors and non-zero SD.

A personal comparison requires compatible completed assessments; supported embedded courses use theory and lab credits. UniCC rounds each contribution up to a whole mark, so the comparable personal total uses the same rounding.

StudentCC requests statistics using your VTOP class number. Your marks, password and VTOP session are not sent to UniCC by this integration.

Open a course to see its assessment scores, weighted total and any released grade. Class insights show separate averages, standard deviation, contributor counts and VIT grade predictions for UniCC and StudentCC.

Each service uses its own contributors. Refresh checks for newer statistics. StudentCC also shows the number of participating students with 9+ CGPA in the class. Sharing starts selected on the sign-in screen. Signing in applies that choice; the Profile switch also enables sharing directly.

Internal grade predictions assume the same percentage performance in the final exam. The university’s final grade depends on the complete class results, applicable grading scheme and pass requirements.
